description: Default options of the yamlprims specification revision 1.0: YAML 1.2.2 Core resolution (section 4), integers limited to i128::MIN..=u128::MAX with out-of-range as a resolution error, explicit core tags directing resolution, non-core tags retained with a raw string inner, duplicate keys rejected (section 5.2), merge directives rejected (section 5.3 default), and a single document per input. Error kinds are the specification's snake_case ErrorKind names.
